category_title: Students with persistent challenging behavior referred for individualized support
scenario_title: Large group reading instruction evoking attention-maintained behavior
minimal_context: The student is participating in a large group reading instruction activity where the class is asked to read from their textbooks.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Everyone, please open your reading books to page 12 so we can read the next chapter together.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Puts head down on desk and starts making inappropriate vocalizations while the rest of the group opens their books.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please sit up and open your book to page 12.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Leaves seat without permission, walks over to the student at the next desk, and starts touching their reading materials.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Go back to your seat and leave their things alone.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Shouts above the current conversational level) I'm not going back! (Takes the peer's reading materials without permission and drops them on the floor.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Everyone, please open your reading books to page 12 so we can read the next chapter together.

STUDENT: (Puts head down on desk and starts making inappropriate vocalizations while the rest of the group opens their books.)

TUTOR: Please sit up and open your book to page 12.

STUDENT: (Leaves seat without permission, walks over to the student at the next desk, and starts touching their reading materials.)

TUTOR: Go back to your seat and leave their things alone.

STUDENT: (Shouts above the current conversational level) I'm not going back! (Takes the peer's reading materials without permission and drops them on the floor.)

task.content: Engaging in academic tasks during large group instruction in reading, language arts, or literacy

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: social positive reinforcement (i.e., access to attention/preferred items)
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: shouting or yelling (above current conversational level); cursing; touching or taking peer or teacher materials without permission

behavior_patterns.condition: During teacher-led instruction or peer interactions
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: inappropriate vocalizations, active noncompliance, and disruptions
